reproduction_summary.live_card: https://agentverse-a2a-production.up.railway.app/.well-known/agent-card.json advertised top-level protocolVersion 0.3, preferredTransport JSONRPC, url=public host, and supportedInterfaces without protocolVersion.
reproduction_summary.sdk_cause: a2a-sdk 1.1.2 agent_card_to_dict() MessageToDict(card) then merges to_compat_agent_card(). When AgentInterface.protocol_version is empty, conversions.to_compat_agent_card treats it as a legacy interface and injects protocol_version=PROTOCOL_VERSION_0_3 ('0.3'). JSON-RPC handlers are @validate_version(PROTOCOL_VERSION_1_0); missing A2A-Version is read as 0.3 (a2a/utils/version_validator.py). enable_v0_3_compat defaults false, so message/send is Method not found and role=user fails lf.a2a.v1 Role parse.
reproduction_summary.local_repro_before: AgentInterface(protocol_binding='JSONRPC', url=...) -> agent_card_to_dict protocolVersion=0.3 plus preferredTransport and url.
reproduction_summary.fix: Set AgentInterface.protocol_version=PROTOCOL_VERSION_1_0 ('1.0'). to_compat_agent_card then has no legacy interfaces, raises VersionNotSupportedError, merge is skipped. Card advertises supportedInterfaces[0].protocolVersion=1.0 only. Official ClientFactory prefers 1.0 and uses JsonRpcTransport (SendMessage + A2A-Version 1.0 + ROLE_USER).
